title: The Four Parts: the new version beside yours
intro: Your published section is on the left. On the right is the new version: highlighted words are new, and struck words are ones that went.

As published, the section read 87% AI. Now it reads 100% Human (1,449 words), and every paragraph passes alone or with a neighbor that passes alone. P8 to P10, P13, P14 and the list under "4. The container" are unchanged: they read Human as published.

Not finished: the gate's three fresh-agent checks (the trace, the cold read and the whole-article stance check) didn't run on the ten paragraphs changed in the last round (P5, P11, P12, P15 to P19, P29, P30), because the account's agents hit their weekly limit. I read those ten myself; the notes say what changed in meaning. Two questions for you, P5 and P16, and two smaller ones, P13 and P31.

headings: The Four Parts That Have to Pl/ork Together

rows.label: P1 · what founders solve
rows.article: Communities tend to focus on the
source: Communities tend to solve whichever part
notes: From Emulate. Its "Too often I’ve seen communities…" became "Communities tend to…": yours is a general claim, and the "I’ve seen" was Emulate's.
Pangram: 100% Human alone.

rows.label: P2 · four parts
rows.article: I’ve broken the model I propose
source: I divide the model into four
notes: From Emulate, with "It’s an arbitrary number" cut (you said four sounds too tidy, not arbitrary), "free … here" made "free to read" (there was no link), and your "God" and "children" back. "Not a sales pitch for a retreat or anything" carries your "no funnel and no retreat to buy".
Pangram: 100% Human alone.

rows.label: P3 · why bind lives
rows.article: In a nutshell, there's a difference
source: Food, housing, and logistics are not
notes: From Emulate, with fixes: "risk our lives" became "commit our whole lives" (bind, not risk); "to stop living in fear" became "be less run by fear" (your "less governed"); "the hard parts mean something" puts back your "gives the difficulty meaning".

The whole-article stance check caught Emulate's "when we take on the purpose of an outward escuelita": it made the outward purpose optional, and section 1 says these communities should do it. Now: "the outward escuelita and federation purpose gives us even more reason".
Pangram: 100% Human alone.

headings: One principle runs through all of them

rows.label: P4 · the principle
rows.article: Nothing suppressed, everything processed. Each of
source: Nothing suppressed, everything processed; authority stays
notes: "Nothing suppressed, everything processed" kept word for word: your Founderism section quotes it. The rest uses Emulate's pieces. "Each of us keeps authority over our own practice": the trace read "the authority on" as expertise, and the stance ledger warned that "practitioner" has to stay the person practicing, not a rule the group enforces.
Pangram: 100% Human after P3. The heading and P4 read 39% AI with P5 after them. The section passes.

rows.label: P5 · the parts tangle
rows.article: There is going to be bleed
source: These categories leak into one another
notes: A question. Your paragraph gives four ways one part turns into another: jealousy into governance, control of shared resources into psychology, medicine into status, child-rearing exposing values the founders never discussed. Both versions that kept all four read 100% AI alone (both mine; Emulate's own versions all dropped them). Emulate's version, here, says how the four tangle without the four directions.

My opinion: take it. The later sections carry the points (jealousy as the hidden governor, no special shaman, child-rearing values before the children come). If you want one direction back, I'd keep jealousy into governance.
Pangram: 100% Human alone, and with P6.

notes: From Emulate; its sentence was cut off, and your "lived experience" finishes it. Your quip's point is back in short form, "every time somebody has a revelation in breathwork": the grounding reviewer said it's what separates constant revision from staying open.
Pangram: 100% Human with P7.

Pangram: 100% Human with P6.

source: The community’s capacity to help people
notes: From one Emulate call over P14 to P19 together. In the section, P13's last sentence to P20 read AI as a run, though each paragraph passed alone; three versions of the run failed, and this one passed (100% Human).

Fixes: one professional or guru, not "a few"; "the founder of the group that everyone emotionally depends on" for Emulate's garbled "most emotionally available (aka indispensable)". "The idea is that" stands in for your "therefore".

rows.label: P16 · care isn’t power
rows.article: Another thing is that the person
source: But care is not jurisdiction. The
notes: Same run. Fixes: "just from that" (your "automatically"); "what happens with your children" and "take part in the medicine work" for Emulate's "see your kids" and "get medication"; "believed in a dispute" (Emulate's other version) for your "the evidence in a dispute about them".

A cold reader couldn't picture the evidence line as published, so "believed in a dispute" is my reading of it; tell me if you meant something else. The last sentence is your "emotional access turns into administrative authority".
Pangram: 100% Human alone, with P15 and with P17.
